full_prompt_en: This is a square, ink-and-watercolor creature illustration on a nearly blank white background. A single lanky figure stands near the center, its narrow blue trousered legs and dark shoes touching a thin scribbled ground shadow near the lower edge. The torso and arms are small and crooked, with one thin hand hanging down and another limb partly lost behind the larger upper form. Above this slight body, an oversized orange-yellow head bursts outward like a splash or flame. Its front edge forms a dark tooth-lined mouth, while pale round openings and red-pink patches interrupt the warm surface. Long tendrils of yellow and orange paint curl upward and to the right, throwing fine droplets into the open white space. The creature leans forward as if moving to the left, and the long trailing splash gives that motion a contrary sweep. Ink-like black contours sharpen the jaw, fingers, trouser seams, and shoe edges, while translucent watercolor blooms soften the orange mass. The white paper retains faint specks and a few stray marks but no built setting, horizon, or writing. Light appears flat and studio-like on the page; volume comes primarily from dark linework, overlapping washes, and the small ground shadow rather than cast illumination. Cool blue-green clothing anchors the figure below the hot orange upper form. The composition leaves generous blank margins, making the complicated silhouette look even more unruly. The overall image feels grotesque and playful, with energetic splashed color balanced by a spare, hand-drawn base.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、墨线与水彩结合的怪物插画，背景近乎空白白色。唯一的瘦长形体位于中央附近，狭窄的蓝色裤腿和深色鞋子接触下边缘附近一道涂写般的地面阴影。躯干和双臂小而弯曲，一只细手向下垂，另一条肢体部分隐在更大的上部形体后。轻微的身体上方，一颗硕大的橙黄色头部像飞溅颜料或火焰般向外爆开。前缘形成一张由深色牙齿排列的嘴，浅色圆孔与红粉斑块打断暖色表面。长长的黄橙颜料触须向上、向右卷曲，把细小液滴甩进开阔白色空间。怪物向前倾，像要朝左移动，长长的后掠飞溅形态提供相反的扫动。墨黑轮廓锐化下颌、手指、裤缝和鞋边，透明水彩晕染则柔化橙色团块。白纸保留轻微斑点与少量游离痕迹，但没有搭建的场景、地平线或文字。页面上的光显得平坦而像影棚光；体积主要由深线、叠加色洗和细小接地阴影构成，而非投射光照。冷蓝绿色衣物固定了炽热橙色上部形体的下方。构图留下宽阔空白边，使复杂剪影更显不羁。整体图像怪诞而俏皮，以充满能量的飞溅色彩平衡稀疏的手绘基底。
style_prompt_en: The ink-and-watercolor treatment combines elastic black contours with translucent washes that bloom, splash, and leave small droplets. A hot orange-yellow focal mass is counterweighted by narrow cool blue-green forms and a tiny dark contact mark. Edges shift from toothlike sharpness to soft stained bleed, giving the surface an unstable, lively feel. Long looping strokes and scattered specks interrupt generous white negative space. Fine crosslines carry structural detail, while larger color areas remain irregular and partially transparent. Light is even across the paper, so color contrast and line density create the hierarchy. The overall effect is unruly, humorous, and slightly unsettling, with material accidents treated as part of the design.
style_prompt_zh: 这种墨线与水彩处理把有弹性的黑色轮廓同会晕开、飞溅并留下细小液滴的透明色洗结合。炽热橙黄色焦点团块由狭窄冷蓝绿色形体和一小处深色接触痕平衡。边缘从牙齿般尖锐过渡到柔软渗色，使表面不稳定而充满活力。长卷线条与散落斑点打断宽阔白色负空间。细密交叉线承载结构细节，大块色域则保持不规则和部分透明。纸面受光均匀，因此色彩反差与线条密度建立主次。整体效果不羁、幽默且略令人不安，把材料意外变化也纳入设计。
theme_en: A lanky creature with an orange flame-like head walking across a blank white field
theme_zh: 一只橙色火焰状头部的瘦长怪物走过空白白色画域
name: Alex Pardee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
